name: WayriCAD Assistant
description: Use local language commands to run suite checks and open generated reports.
description_full: Local fuzzy intent matching coordinates registered read-only WayriCAD CLI actions. Shows plans, asks for missing inputs and offers saved-board visual net selection. No cloud, downloaded language model or automatic layout edits. Existing tool runtimes and numerical limits still apply. Independent KiCad 10 IPC plugin.
